item.title: github: Copilot impact dashboard adds chat and VS Code agent usage
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Impact dashboard’s Agent adoption chart now includes Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, expanding coverage to nine Copilot experiences. This lets admins view engagement across those additional surfaces in the dashboard.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now lets users control the default model and MCP server, and includes updates that make diagnostics easier to resolve. The release also improves chat navigation and account controls.

  • Source: GitHub
